task_text: Inertial cube flip, chute run and pocket recovery: A cube rests on a raised launch surface. With a short push from the pusher blade, tip it over so that the face that initially faces the robot (-x) ends up on top, the cube completing the tip by its own momentum after the blade has let go, and let it settle. Then push the flipped cube onto an inclined chute, let it slide down by itself, meet it with the blade on its downhill side near the chute's lower end, and bring it to rest in the pocket at the bottom of the chute with the same face still on top. Phases, in order: momentum_face_flip: let tilt be the angle between the cube's initially vertical axis and world up. The blade's last contact with the cube must end while the tilt is between 0.03 and pi/4 - 0.02 = 0.765 rad (1.7 to 43.9 deg), and at some step more than 20 ms after that last contact the cube must still turn faster than 0.4 rad/s (an early release); the tilt must then pass pi/4 (45 deg) without further blade contact. After that the cube must lie with its original -x face on top (that face's outward normal within 0.18 rad of world +z), moving at less than 0.05 m/s and turning at less than 0.3 rad/s, touching the launch surface, for 0.25 s without interruption. Touching the cube with the blade again after the early release and before the tilt has passed 45 deg fails the task (flip_recontact_before_balance).; oriented_chute_entry: the cube touches the chute while its centre is at world x > 0.18 m and its original -x face points away from the chute surface (that face's outward normal within 0.35 rad (20.1 deg) of the chute surface's normal). The cube's position along the chute's downhill direction at that moment is recorded as the start of its free slide.; downstream_intercept: the phase completes at a step where the cube touches the blade and at the same time: the cube's centre is at world x > 0.32 m; the cube touches the chute; the blade's tool-frame origin lies on the downhill side of the cube's centre (positive component along the chute's downhill direction); since the start of its free slide the cube's centre has moved at least `free_slide` = 0.12 m along the chute's downhill direction; and on the previous physics step the cube's velocity component down the chute was at least 0.33 m/s. Any cube-blade contact that does not meet all of these restarts the free slide from the cube's current position.; pocket_delivery: the cube touches the pocket, its centre is within 0.04 m (horizontal distance) of the pocket's centre, its original -x face is on top (outward normal within 0.18 rad of world +z), it moves at less than 0.04 m/s and turns at less than 0.2 rad/s, for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Chute-entry line: cube centre at world x > 0.18 m (oriented_chute_entry). Intercept line: cube centre at world x > 0.32 m (downstream_intercept). The delivery target is the pocket's centre (a physical fixture).
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where the task has succeeded (every phase in order) or failed (a failure event, a forbidden contact, a safety-limit violation, an object out of bounds, or the task's horizon of 25 s of simulated time, 2500 control steps), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
